config.description: Method replication: the images are new Baidu 360° street panoramas of central Lhasa, shown flat (the paper stitched four Baidu views per point), not the paper's images. Participants look at each panorama for at least 10 seconds and score the 16 statements of the Tibetan Buddhist perception scale (religion, sacred, respect, commandment; adapted by the authors from Laumann's Restorative Components Scale) from 0 (very inconsistent with my feelings) to 6 (very consistent), as the 30 volunteers did in Gadan & Zhang (2024, PLOS ONE). Statement wording is as printed in the paper's Table 1. Differences from the original study: each volunteer in the paper scored 50 images; here each participant scores 10 random panoramas.

paper.title: Spiritual places: Spatial recognition of Tibetan Buddhist spiritual perception
